description_en: Wakes up cloud computers from hibernation
description_zh: 对云电脑执行唤醒操作
kebab_example: aliyun ecd wakeup-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-j2eoqgf5u4mwj0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: WakeupDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of cloud computers. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id
